verdict.rationale: Gemini's own help docs describe scheduling recurring actions on daily, weekly, and monthly cadences, for example a daily news digest, so it is a true recurring schedule rather than a one-off action. The Batch API is asynchronous one-off processing, not scheduling, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step workflow chaining and of how scheduled actions are managed, edited or limited, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled actions run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: You can make Gemini a part of your daily, weekly, and monthly routines by scheduling recurring actions.
For example, you can schedule actions in Gemini Apps to get: A daily news digest on topics that matter most to you
